title: Carry on a pharmacy business only at registered premises
what: Provide restricted pharmacy services, and own a pharmacy business, only at premises registered as a pharmacy.

laws.title: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (South Australia) Act 2010 (SA)

sources.title: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (South Australia) Act 2010 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not provide restricted pharmacy services except at premises registered as a pharmacy under this section.

sources.title: Health Practitioner Regulation National Law (South Australia) Act 2010 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not own, or hold a proprietary interest in, a pharmacy business unless the business is carried on at premises registered as a pharmacy under this section.
